title: Polynomial work bound for the learner
statement: Let the dimension be $n>0$, let the accuracy be $ho=a/b$ for positive integers $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and let $M\ge1$ be an integer Fourier $1$-norm bound. For every sign-valued Boolean target on the $n$-dimensional cube, the learner's charged work, viewed as a real number, is at most $2^{170}\left((n+1)(M+1)/\rho\right)^{100}$.
hypotheses_covered: Accuracy numerator and denominator satisfy $2a\le b$
Target is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
